en.bio: Dongxu Yue is a PhD student (2025 intake) in Computer Science and Technology at Tsinghua University, supervised by Professor Chun Yuan at Tsinghua University and Professor Zhihai He at SUSTech. His research focuses on computer vision and generative AI, particularly diffusion-based controllable image generation and editing, including personalized portrait generation, identity preservation, and physically consistent image editing.
